title: SEC Insider Conviction Pipeline Input
description: Pass a list of tickers or CIKs. The pipeline pulls Form 4 insider transactions and 8-K material events from SEC EDGAR over your lookback window, joins them per company on issuer CIK, and scores each company 0-100 on insider buy intensity plus material catalysts. Optionally enrich with LinkedIn hiring momentum.

tickers.title: Tickers to watch
tickers.description: Stock tickers to evaluate. Examples: ["NVDA", "AAPL", "PLTR"]. Provide tickers or CIKs (at least one list is required).

ciks.title: CIKs to watch
ciks.description: SEC Central Index Keys, if you prefer them over tickers. Leading zeros are optional. Combines with the ticker list.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback window (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back to evaluate insider transactions and 8-K filings. 90 days captures a quarter of accumulation without stale signal.

minBuyValueUsd.title: Minimum insider buy value (USD)
minBuyValueUsd.description: Ignore insider transactions below this dollar value. 0 includes every reported transaction. Raise it to filter out token purchases.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max filings per source
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows pulled from each EDGAR source (Form 4 and 8-K) per run. Controls total cost.

includeHiringEnrichment.title: Add LinkedIn hiring enrichment
includeHiringEnrichment.description: Optional. When on AND you supply the ticker to LinkedIn URL map below, the pipeline adds hiring momentum to the conviction score. Off keeps the run 100% SEC EDGAR with no antibot exposure.

linkedinCompanyMap.title: Ticker to LinkedIn company URL map
linkedinCompanyMap.description: Only used when hiring enrichment is on. Each entry maps a ticker to its LinkedIn company URL, e.g. {"ticker": "NVDA", "companyUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/nvidia/"}. There is no automatic ticker to LinkedIn lookup, so you must supply these.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy passed to the child actors. EDGAR does not require a proxy; the LinkedIn enrichment stage benefits from residential.
